text:
Samira (CS): quick import from last 3 onboarding calls  11 asks, mostly about per-route cost visibility, pin-by-route model control, and simple invoices. Can PM/Eng react: \u2705 = roadmap, \ud83d\udd0d = research, \u26a0\ufe0f = churn risk

triage-bot: Uploaded onboarding_batch_2026_10_02.csv (11 rows). Auto-tags: per-route-billing, pin-by-route, invoices, docs.

Owen (PM): paste of top 3 (arr & short note):
```
customer,tier,ask
HarborOne,A,per-route billing CSV + daily rollup to reconcile invoices
NimbleMed,A,pin model per-route so low-priority routes use smaller model
SmallStart,B,clear docs/examples for batching embeddings to lower cost
```

Felix (Eng): HarborOne export is fine if we only include route_id, tokens, cost_est. No raw prompts. Low effort for interim CSV (1 day), full API export ~1 week.

Maya (Billing): agrees. Add schema: route_id, date, total_tokens, unit_cost, cost_estimate. No user identifiers.

Samira (CS): marking HarborOne & NimbleMed as \u26a0\ufe0f due to onboarding pushback on cost.

Owen (PM): reacting \u2705 to SmallStart docs snippet (easy win). Marking NimbleMed \ud83d\udd0d - needs UX decision for console.

Felix (Eng): technical note for pin-by-route: backend runtime supports model aliasing today, console UX + ACLs the main work. Estimate: 2 backend days + 3 frontend days. Could pilot with a toggle + docs.

triage-bot: Flagged 4 accounts as "at-risk" during import: HarborOne, NimbleMed, FleetWave, BrightCart.

Samira (CS): process ask: if anything is a privacy/regulatory no-go call it out so CS stops promising.

Felix (Eng): hard-no on exporting raw request payloads. Otherwise all asks are feasible.

Owen (PM): scheduling 25-min rapid triage 10:30am PT tomorrow. Agenda: 1) interim CSV for HarborOne, 2) pin-by-route UX options & pilot, 3) assign owners. Invite: @Felix @Samira @Maya

Samira (CS): perfect  I'll send interim CSVs to HarborOne and follow up after triage. :thumbsup:
